messages:
maria: Prometheus alert fired for cardinality spike on our gpu metrics, +80k series in 10m. Anyone touching node/dcgm exporters?
ajay: saw that, digging. Looks like new driver installed on eu-west nodes earlier which added per-device serial/uuid labels to node_exporter metrics.
lee: can you paste the alert?
maria: alert: HighMetricSeriesGrowth (fired)
  expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_head_series{job=\"node-exporter\"}[10m]) > 5000
  note: series jump mostly on metrics with label gpu_serial and runtime_pod_id
sam: ops-bot posted a deploy earlier: `infra/driver-update` finished at 1802001000 for eu-west-1. Could be correlated.
monitoring-bot: :warning: alert pushed to #eng-infra at 1802001220 (HighMetricSeriesGrowth)
ajay: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=dcgm-exporter -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'` returns multiple dcgm-exporter pods per node because systemd unit churn + kubelet static pod restart race. We had duplicates briefly exposing same metrics with different instance labels.
lee: ugh. So two orthogonal issues: driver introduced extra labels (per-device serial), and dcgm exporter restart duplicated metrics. Both add cardinality.
maria: sample series names: `dcgm_gpu_temperature{gpu_serial=\"GPU-1234-...\",pod=\"dcgm-exporter-abc\"}` and `dcgm_gpu_temperature{gpu_serial=\"GPU-1234-...\",pod=\"dcgm-exporter-abc-1\"}`
sam: for immediate mitigation, we should relabel out the gpu_serial or replace with index. Proposed relabel_config for Prometheus scrape:```relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
  action: keep
  regex: dcgm-exporter
- source_labels: [gpu_serial]
  action: replace
  target_label: gpu_index
  regex: \".*-(\\d+)\"
  replacement: \"$1\"
- action: labeldrop
  regex: gpu_serial|runtime_pod_id
```
lee: labeldrop looks good short-term. But we must be careful not to lose uniqueness across multi-GPU nodes. Maybe keep gpu_index + node name.
ajay: agreed. Also for DCGM race: change the systemd/static pod config so exporter binds to host port with `--pid-file` or `--instance $(NODE_NAME)` so two processes don't register same metrics. Current static pod uses emptyDir + restartPolicy causing quick duplicate pods.
maria: can we patch the daemonset to include `--instance=$(NODE_NAME)` in args and update readinessProbe to wait for `/var/lib/dcgm/ready`?
sam: created quick change: `kubectl -n infra set env ds/dcgm-exporter INSTANCE_FROM_NODE_NAME=1` and updated args in a canary on 2 nodes. Monitoring shows series count dropping back toward baseline.
lee: nice. For durable fix, propose: 1) revert driver label addition (ask kernel/driver team) or make exporter drop the gpu_serial label via exporter flag; 2) add relabeling in Prometheus to labeldrop gpu_serial and runtime_pod_id; 3) ensure dcgm-exporter static pods are registered via nodeName and have unique instance label.
ajay: I'll open an infra ticket and schedule a small rollout: patch dcgm daemonset, apply Prometheus relabel, and coordinate with driver rollback if needed.
maria: thanks. Also add an alert tweak: make HighMetricSeriesGrowth alert reference `job=~\"(node-exporter|dcgm-exporter)\"` and add suppression window for 5m after infra deploys.
sam: created PRs: https://git.redwood/infraproj/ops/+/1234 (prometheus relabel) and https://git.redwood/infraproj/ops/+/1235 (dcgm args + readiness).
monitoring-bot: :white_check_mark: PR 1234 merged to staging at 1802001320; PR 1235 merged to staging at 1802001350
maria: monitoring lookback shows series reduced by ~70% after relabels on staging nodes. Will roll to prod after smoke window.
lee: thanks all — follow-ups: ajay will coordinate driver team, sam will run canary, maria will monitor alerts and update runbook. :thumbsup:
